rationale.complete: Round 1, synthetic validation and the pre-registered #45 holdout test are all done; the talk/mention spins, the Hawkes comparison and the #14/#49 transfer set remain.
rationale.faithfulness: The core claim (pairwise couplings measure influence) was refuted on the locked holdout and pairwise J never beat the nulls; only a weak mean-field co-activation beats N1 in some chunks, and its forward P(K) test failed.
rationale.usefulness: A well-controlled negative: it tells operators not to infer leaders or influence from activity timing, which saves effort but gives no positive handle.

one_line: Activity-timing Ising couplings are null-level and missed the installed #45 leader; only shared lulls remain
